propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures are invisible to plan-review verdict consumers because failed calls are swallowed into abstain/degrade defaults and never recorded in the output JSON.
The runner seam at PydanticAIRunner.run:573 is the single convergence point for all LLM call failures but only writes to a JSONL spend log, not to in-memory verdict state.
Plan-review verdict coverage lacks a counter for survived LLM step failures; coverage.chunk_errors exists but is write-only with no reader and only covers Pass-1 chunks.

An observability-only sink must record failed steps at the runner seam, activate scoped recording during gate run, and drain into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty to maintain attestation safety.
The failure counter must be keyed by step _call_label and presented only when failures occurred, keeping clean run verdicts byte-identical to pre-change output.
